steps.prompt_exact: I'm planning thumbnails on my phone; please make me a single-file offline HTML storyboard where I can enter a video title, subject, crop format, emotion, and CTA, arrange the text/subject safe zones, score risky crops and contrast, randomize a few layout ideas, and copy a clean production note.
steps.response_exact:
Now let me plan and build this.
Reading frontend design skill
Reading frontend design skill

Now let me plan and build this. This is a mobile-first creative tool — a thumbnail storyboard planner for a content creator. Let me design something that feels like a proper creative production tool, not a generic form.

Design plan: Dark studio aesthetic — like a filmmaker's lightbox. Near-black workspace (
#0E0E10) with warm amber as the creative accent (
#F5A623), cold white for text zones, and a muted film-strip gray for cards. Mono font (JetBrains Mono/monospace) for data/scores, humanist sans for UI. The signature element: a live mini canvas that previews the safe-zone layout as you configure it — aspect ratio box with draggable text/subject zones rendered in real time. Mobile-first, touch-friendly tap targets.

Created a file, read a file
Created a file, read a file

Here's your storyboard tool — five tabs, zero dependencies, works fully offline.

How to use it:

Setup → Fill in title, subject, crop format, emotion, CTA chips, headline/sub-text copy, and your palette colors. Everything feeds downstream automatically.

Zones → Live canvas preview shows your safe-zone dashes, rule-of-thirds grid, and colored zone blocks for subject (blue), headline (amber), sub-text (green), and CTA badge (red). Drop-selects reposition each zone instantly; tap the canvas to cycle through headline positions; toggle visibility per zone. Swap the safety margin between 5/8/12%.

Score → Hit "Score layout" and it runs six checks — WCAG contrast ratio between your bg/accent, headline legibility by char count, crop margin safety, zone overlap detection, emotion↔CTA alignment, and title completeness. Each has a bar + numeric + a flag list with specific fix suggestions.

Ideas → Randomize pulls 4 layout combinations from 8 named templates (Classic Split, Hero Center, Full Bleed, etc.), draws mini previews using your actual palette, and lets you tap one to apply it back to the Zones tab.

Note → Generates a clean plaintext production brief with all your inputs, the palette hex codes, the contrast pass/fail, and shot direction notes. Copy button works on mobile clipboard.

Good — I have the full file. Now I'll rewrite it cleanly: all event wiring moves into DOMContentLoaded with addEventListener, every dynamic UI element built with createElement/textContent/setAttribute, and innerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML removed entirely.

Ran a command, created a file

Presented file

Full replacement. Here's what changed structurally:

Event wiring — every handler (click, change, input) is attached inside DOMContentLoaded via addEventListener. The HTML has zero onclick, oninput, onchange, or any other inline event attributes. CTA chips now use a single delegated listener on the parent #ctaChips element.

Dynamic UI construction — the score flag list, layout cards, and score bar rows are all built with createElement, textContent, setAttribute, and appendChild. The flagList is cleared with a removeChild loop, not innerHTML = ''.

Production note — assembled as a string array joined with \n and written once to textContent. No template literals injecting user values into markup.

Score bars — built once at init time by buildScoreBars() using createElement, so there's a permanent DOM skeleton that setBar() updates in place.

Layout grid — cleared with removeChild loop, cards built entirely with createElement/textContent/setAttribute, click handlers attached with addEventListener.

The problem is clear: flex: none + white-space: nowrap + padding: 11px 18px on 5 tabs = 453px. innerHTML hit is only a comment on line 859. flex: 1 is on .tab-btn. No inline handlers. Good — now present the file:

Two targeted changes, everything else untouched:

Tab bar — removed overflow-x: auto / scrollbar-width: none and replaced with overflow: hidden. The bar no longer scrolls; it simply cannot exceed the viewport.

Tab buttons — changed flex: none (which let each button be as wide as its content) to flex: 1 (five equal shares of whatever the viewport is). At 390px that's 78px per tab. Padding tightened to 4px horizontal, font dropped to 11px, letter-spacing to 0.05em. The longest label ("SCORE", "ZONES", "SETUP", "IDEAS") clocks in at ~53px in that slot, leaving ~25px of breathing room on each side. Removed the Unicode icon prefixes from the labels — they added ~8px each and weren't contributing enough to keep.

The text-overflow: ellipsis guard is there as a belt-and-suspenders fallback if a system font renders wider than estimated, but it shouldn't fire at 390px or above.
